result.instruction: In `debouncer_top`, replace the child instance with a 7-bit history register and registered `clean`; synchronously clear both on active-high `rst`, shift in `noisy` each other rising edge, and update `clean` when all seven prior history bits equal the current `noisy` value. This must change `clean` on the eighth consecutive sample, preserve reset and registered-output behavior, and retain `// @latency 0`. Target fewer than 4 routed LUTs; keep the candidate only if it passes every gate and beats the timing-feasible incumbent under the strict LUT/FF objective.
